# agents-js

> ACP runtimes over A2A — operator CLI and reusable client library for building agent surfaces.

## Overview

- [index.md](https://agents-js.bodal.dev/index.html): What agents-js is, how the pieces fit together, and the feature inventory.

## Getting Started

- [getting-started.md](https://agents-js.bodal.dev/getting-started.html): Run a local ACP runtime behind an A2A gateway in one command, browser or CLI.
- [surfaces.md](https://agents-js.bodal.dev/surfaces.html): The shipped consumer surfaces — browser app, CLI, and multi-agent dispatch.

## Core Concepts

- [primitives.md](https://agents-js.bodal.dev/primitives.html): Composable packages: protocol primitives, tool surface (fetchContext, findTools, spawnAgent), and the Ports & Adapters layering.
- [protocols.md](https://agents-js.bodal.dev/protocols.html): Canonical map of JSON-RPC, ACP, A2A, MCP, AG-UI, A2UI, and runtime manifests — what is implemented, validated, or passed through.
- [harness-guide.md](https://agents-js.bodal.dev/harness-guide.html): Building a harness on agents-js: Gen-1 through Gen-3 agent integrations, permissions, terminals, and the host adapter seams.
- [streaming-and-events.md](https://agents-js.bodal.dev/streaming-and-events.html): Event vocabularies and streaming behavior across ACP, A2A, and AG-UI.

## Operations

- [observability.md](https://agents-js.bodal.dev/observability.html): Logger, logStore, EvalTransport, and the tool-call-trace v0.1 structured event schema for observability and audit.

## Per-package indexes

- [@agents-js/a2a](https://agents-js.bodal.dev/per-package/agents-js-a2a-llms.txt): A2A server — wraps an ACP agent as an HTTP JSON-RPC + SSE streaming endpoint with CORS support.
- [@agents-js/a2a-client](https://agents-js.bodal.dev/per-package/agents-js-a2a-client-llms.txt): A2A client transport, AG-UI adapter, target registry, session view-model, and discovery helpers for agents-js consumers.
- [@agents-js/a2ui-host](https://agents-js.bodal.dev/per-package/agents-js-a2ui-host-llms.txt): Browser-side A2UI v0.9 host and bridge for agents-js.
- [@agents-js/a2ui-renderer](https://agents-js.bodal.dev/per-package/agents-js-a2ui-renderer-llms.txt): Maps A2UI component trees onto the acp-* Lit primitives shipped by agents-js.
- [@agents-js/a2ui-types](https://agents-js.bodal.dev/per-package/agents-js-a2ui-types-llms.txt): Thin re-export layer over @a2ui/web_core v0.9 plus a custom catalog for agents-js.
- [@agents-js/acp](https://agents-js.bodal.dev/per-package/agents-js-acp-llms.txt): Low-level ACP client — spawns an agent process, communicates over stdio/NDJSON, and manages the ACP protocol lifecycle.
- [@agents-js/acp-host](https://agents-js.bodal.dev/per-package/agents-js-acp-host-llms.txt): Stateful ACP host embedding surface. Manages agent sessions, terminal processes, permissions, and file I/O for host applications.
- [@agents-js/agui-types](https://agents-js.bodal.dev/per-package/agents-js-agui-types-llms.txt): AG-UI core re-exports plus first-party message, reasoning, run, tool-call, and stream helpers for agents-js.
- [@agents-js/canvas-model](https://agents-js.bodal.dev/per-package/agents-js-canvas-model-llms.txt): Dependency-free canvas document model helpers for agents-js A2UI payload handoff, OCIF-style preservation, and JSON Canvas preview export.
- [@agents-js/cli](https://agents-js.bodal.dev/per-package/agents-js-cli-llms.txt): Terminal TUI and server commands for agents-js. Provides the agents-js executable with serve, client, and acp subcommands.
- [@agents-js/gateway-runtime](https://agents-js.bodal.dev/per-package/agents-js-gateway-runtime-llms.txt): Gateway runtime config, env parsing, runtime registry/detection, install descriptors, and sub-session spawn helpers.
- [@agents-js/host](https://agents-js.bodal.dev/per-package/agents-js-host-llms.txt): Host orchestration for the agents-js A2A gateway: ACP-backed A2A executor, AG-UI fetch handler, WebSocket bridge, and surface broadcaster.
- [@agents-js/mcp-bridge](https://agents-js.bodal.dev/per-package/agents-js-mcp-bridge-llms.txt): MCP server that exposes A2A agents as MCP tools. Each configured agent becomes a callable tool.
- [@agents-js/memory](https://agents-js.bodal.dev/per-package/agents-js-memory-llms.txt): Library-agnostic write-side memory primitive for agents-js. Defines MemoryProvider, actor/scope/record types, and a conformance harness for backend implementations.
- [@agents-js/memory-local](https://agents-js.bodal.dev/per-package/agents-js-memory-local-llms.txt): Local single-process MemoryProvider for agents-js (Bun runtime only — depends on `bun:sqlite`). Backed by a pluggable storage seam (sqlite by default) with an optional policy-gate hook.
- [@agents-js/memory-postgres](https://agents-js.bodal.dev/per-package/agents-js-memory-postgres-llms.txt): PostgreSQL Storage backend for the agents-js MemoryProvider. Plugs into @agents-js/memory-local's LocalMemoryProvider via the public Storage seam. Implements substrate read primitives (get + listByScope) per ADR 0001 using indexed cursor-based pagination.
- [@agents-js/policy](https://agents-js.bodal.dev/per-package/agents-js-policy-llms.txt): Stateless permission policy evaluation for ACP hosts. Pure functions with no framework dependencies.
- [@agents-js/schema-utils](https://agents-js.bodal.dev/per-package/agents-js-schema-utils-llms.txt): Shared schema property parsing for ACP elicitation forms. Extracts field metadata from JSON Schema-like property definitions.
- [@agents-js/skills](https://agents-js.bodal.dev/per-package/agents-js-skills-llms.txt): TypeScript-native skill loading, validation, and in-memory registry for SKILL.md-formatted skills. Pure, filesystem-only, no network or persistence.
- [@agents-js/tools](https://agents-js.bodal.dev/per-package/agents-js-tools-llms.txt): Unified tool surface for agents-js: fetchContext coordinator (Shape 1) + findTools discovery surface (Shape 2). Single package for memory recall and tool discovery with a shared provenance schema.
- [@agents-js/ui-components](https://agents-js.bodal.dev/per-package/agents-js-ui-components-llms.txt): Lit web components for ACP-aware chat interfaces. Drop-in surface with streaming, permissions, elicitation, auth, and theming.
- [@agents-js/validation](https://agents-js.bodal.dev/per-package/agents-js-validation-llms.txt): Schema validation for ACP envelopes, A2A requests/responses, runtime manifests, and JSON-RPC messages.

## Optional

- [develop/contribute.md](https://agents-js.bodal.dev/develop/contribute.html): Contributor + release-playbook reference. Not needed for first-time readers.
- [develop/browser-entry-points.md](https://agents-js.bodal.dev/develop/browser-entry-points.html): Browser-safe package entry conventions for packages with server-only main entries.
